$comment: Body kinds (docs/BUILT_BODIES.md §2, ADR 0052): what may be done to a moving body of voxel cells, by its kind. The order is the wire's (EntitySpawn's `kind`: 0 is the first). place: a block placed against one of its cells joins it. break: a cell of it may be broken. split: a break that leaves its cells in more than one connected group splits it into bodies of the same kind. settles: at rest it becomes blocks again (docs/FELLING.md §4); else it stays a body. saved: saved with the world. startedBy: blocks that, placed, start a body of this kind instead of going in the world's grid (the build platform; docs/BUILT_BODIES.md §3). Owner, 2026-11-02: natural objects (felled trees, falling sand, loose leaves) can only be broken, not built on; built ones (the build platform's) both; splits for both; built ones never settle. water: how bodies float (docs/BUILT_BODIES.md §6): each cell is pushed up by the liquid it is in (its fraction under it, sampled at its centre and corners) by the liquid's own density, and a body in water is slowed: drag (/s) on its velocity and angularDrag (/s) on its spin, by how much of it is under. Run `node shared/physics/gen.mjs` after editing; CI fails if crates/dwell-sim/src/bodies.gen.rs is stale.
